query: The study received ethical approval from the University of Nottingham Research Ethics Committee (Reference number 276-1802)

query: and informed written consent, and consent to publish, was obtained from each participant, or where appropriate, the parents of the participants.

query: A single trial comprised approximately 0.5 s of stimulation during which the finger was tapped three times using all eight pins.
matched_segment: A single trial comprised approximately 0.5 s of stimulation during which the finger was tapped three times using all eight pins.

query: Pins were up for 82 ms during each 'tap' and down for 82 ms between 'taps'.
matched_segment: Pins were up for 82 ms during each 'tap' and down for 82 ms between 'taps'.

query: This was followed by 3 s rest.
matched_segment: This was followed by 3 s rest.

query: The finger stimulated (index or little) was alternated between trials.
matched_segment: The finger stimulated (index or little) was alternated between trials.

query: There was a total of 42 trials for each finger, meaning the experiment lasted a total of 294 s.
matched_segment: There was a total of 42 trials for each finger, meaning the experiment lasted a total of 294 s.

query: Throughout the experiment, participants watched a television program of their choice (presented via projection onto a screen in the MSR, using a View Sonic PX748-4K projector at 60 Hz refresh rate).
matched_segment: Throughout the experiment, participants watched a television program of their choice (presented via projection onto a screen in the MSR, using a View Sonic PX748-4K projector at 60 Hz refresh rate).

query: All children were accompanied by a parent and one experimenter throughout their visit.
matched_segment: All children were accompanied by a parent and one experimenter throughout their visit.

query: MEG data were collected at a sampling rate of 1200 Hz (16-bit precision) using a National Instruments (NI, Texas, USA) data acquisition system interfaced with LabVIEW (NI).
matched_segment: MEG data were collected at a sampling rate of 1200 Hz (16-bit precision) using a National Instruments (NI, Texas, USA) data acquisition system interfaced with LabVIEW (NI).

query: The head-only digitisation was used to measure head size and shape, and an age-matched T1-weighted template MRI scan was selected from a database (Richards, 2019) and warped to fit the digitisation, using FLIRT in FSL (Jenkinson et al., 2002; Jenkinson and Smith, 2001).
matched_segment: The head-only digitisation was used to measure head size and shape, and an age-matched T1-weighted template MRI scan was selected from a database (Richards, 2019) and warped to fit the digitisation, using FLIRT in FSL (Jenkinson et al., 2002; Jenkinson and Smith, 2001).

query: This procedure resulted in a 'pseudo-MRI' which provided an approximation of the subject's brain anatomy.
matched_segment: This procedure resulted in a 'pseudo-MRI' which provided an approximation of the subject's brain anatomy.

query: Briefly, broken or excessively noisy channels were identified by manual visual inspection of channel power spectra; any channels that were either excessively noisy, or had zero amplitude, were removed.
matched_segment: Briefly, broken or excessively noisy channels were identified by manual visual inspection of channel power spectra; any channels that were either excessively noisy, or had zero amplitude, were removed.

query: Automatic trial rejection was implemented with trials containing abnormally high variance (exceeding 3 standard deviations from the mean) removed.
matched_segment: Automatic trial rejection was implemented with trials containing abnormally high variance (exceeding 3 standard deviations from the mean) removed.

query: All experimental trials were also inspected visually by an experienced MEG scientist, to exclude trials with large spikes/drifts that were missed by the automatic approach.
matched_segment: All experimental trials were also inspected visually by an experienced MEG scientist, to exclude trials with large spikes/drifts that were missed by the automatic approach.

query: In the adult group, there was a significant overlap between automatically and manually detected bad trials (0.7±1.6 trials were only detected manually).
matched_segment: In the adult group, there was a significant overlap between automatically and manually detected bad trials (0.7±1.6 trials were only detected manually).

query: In the children 10.0±9.4 trials were only detected manually.
matched_segment: In the children 10.0±9.4 trials were only detected manually.

query: Notch filters at the powerline frequency (50 Hz) and 2 harmonics, and a 1–150 Hz band pass filter, were applied.
matched_segment: Notch filters at the powerline frequency (50 Hz) and 2 harmonics, and a 1–150 Hz band pass filter, were applied.

query: Finally, eye blink and cardiac artefacts were removed using ICA (implemented in FieldTrip; Oostenveld et al., 2011)
matched_segment: Finally, eye blink and cardiac artefacts were removed using ICA (implemented in FieldTrip; Oostenveld et al., 2011)

query: and homogeneous field correction was applied to reduce interference (Tierney et al., 2021).
matched_segment: and homogeneous field correction was applied to reduce interference (Tierney et al., 2021).

query: For source estimation, we used an LCMV beamformer spatial filter (Van Veen et al., 1997).
matched_segment: For source estimation, we used an LCMV beamformer spatial filter (Van Veen et al., 1997).

query: For all analyses, covariance matrices were generated using data acquired throughout the whole experiment (excluding bad channels and trials).
matched_segment: For all analyses, covariance matrices were generated using data acquired throughout the whole experiment (excluding bad channels and trials).

query: Covariance matrices were regularised using the Tikhonov method with a regularisation parameter equal to 5% of the maximum eigenvalue of the unregularised matrix.
matched_segment: Covariance matrices were regularised using the Tikhonov method with a regularisation parameter equal to 5% of the maximum eigenvalue of the unregularised matrix.

query: The forward model was based on a single shell volumetric conductor (Nolte, 2003).
matched_segment: The forward model was based on a single shell volumetric conductor (Nolte, 2003).

query: Voxels were placed on both an isotropic 4 mm grid covering the whole brain and a 1 mm grid covering the contralateral sensorimotor regions.
matched_segment: Voxels were placed on both an isotropic 4 mm grid covering the whole brain and a 1 mm grid covering the contralateral sensorimotor regions.

query: For each voxel, we contrasted power in active (0.3–0.8 s) and control (2.5–3 s) time windows to generate images showing the spatial signature of beta band modulation.
matched_segment: For each voxel, we contrasted power in active (0.3–0.8 s) and control (2.5–3 s) time windows to generate images showing the spatial signature of beta band modulation.

query: To estimate beta burst timings we employed a three-state, time-delay embedded univariate HMM (Vidaurre et al., 2016).
matched_segment: To estimate beta burst timings we employed a three-state, time-delay embedded univariate HMM (Vidaurre et al., 2016).

query: The HMM was used to divide this time course into three 'states' each depicting repeating patterns of activity with similar temporo-spectral signatures.
matched_segment: The HMM was used to divide this time course into three 'states' each depicting repeating patterns of activity with similar temporo-spectral signatures.

query: The state whose probability of occurrence modulated most with the task was defined as the 'burst state'.
matched_segment: The state whose probability of occurrence modulated most with the task was defined as the 'burst state'.
